author: Apple
description:
Go behind the scenes to see how the team behind the Apple Games campaign film blended stop-motion animation with CGI. Watch how they sculpted and painted game characters, built multiple versions of the Apple Games rocket by hand, and animated everything frame by frame alongside digital effects. 

Learn more about Apple Games: https://games.apple.com

“Miles Up” by Forest Claudette & Will Bloomfield 

Welcome to the official Apple YouTube channel. Here you’ll find news about product launches, tutorials, and other great content. Our more than 160,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth, and to leaving the world better than we found it.
title: Apple Games: Behind the Scenes of Stop-Motion Animation
